attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: game_and_schedule_management
steps:
  - id: receive_game_form
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/games/scheduling-form"
    output: raw_game_form

  - id: authenticate_admin
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "admin"
    output: auth_result

  - id: validate_game_form
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_game_form
      schema:
        type: object
        required:
          - home_team
          - away_team
          - league
          - date
          - time
          - venue
        properties:
          home_team:
            type: string
          away_team:
            type: string
          league:
            type: string
          date:
            type: string
            format: date
          time:
            type: string
          venue:
            type: string
    output: validated_game_form

  - id: extract_league
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_game_form
      field: "league"
    output: league_id

  - id: fetch_league_teams
    op: read_database
    params:
      table: teams
      conditions:
        league: league_id
    output: raw_league_teams

  - id: validate_league_teams
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_league_teams
      schema:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          required:
            - team_id
            - league
    output: league_teams

  - id: check_teams_in_league
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "both home_team and away_team from validated_game_form must exist in league_teams"
      input_form: validated_game_form
      input_teams: league_teams
    output: teams_in_league_result

  - id: route_teams_invalid
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "teams_in_league_result.passed == false"
      target: terminate_invalid_teams

  - id: extract_home_team
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_game_form
      field: "home_team"
    output: home_team_id

  - id: extract_away_team
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_game_form
      field: "away_team"
    output: away_team_id

  - id: extract_game_date
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_game_form
      field: "date"
    output: game_date

  - id: fetch_existing_games
    op: read_database
    params:
      table: games
      conditions:
        date: game_date
    output: raw_existing_games

  - id: filter_existing_games
    op: filter_records
    params:
      input: raw_existing_games
      condition: "record.home_team == home_team_id OR record.away_team == home_team_id OR record.home_team == away_team_id OR record.away_team == away_team_id"
    output: conflicting_games

  - id: apply_conflict_rule
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "conflicting_games must be empty; a team cannot play two games on the same date"
      input: conflicting_games
    output: conflict_check_result

  - id: route_conflict_found
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "conflict_check_result.passed == false"
      target: terminate_conflict

  - id: transform_game_record
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_game_form
      mapping:
        home_team: "$.home_team"
        away_team: "$.away_team"
        league: "$.league"
        date: "$.date"
        time: "$.time"
        venue: "$.venue"
        status: "scheduled"
    output: game_record

  - id: insert_game_record
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: game_record
      table: games
    output: write_result

  - id: log_game_scheduled
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: game_record
      action: "game_scheduled"
      performed_by: auth_result
    output: audit_log_entry

  - id: notify_admin_success
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: game_record
      recipient: auth_result
      message: "Game successfully scheduled."
    output: notification_result

  - id: terminate_success
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "success"
      message: "Game record inserted with status 'scheduled'."

  - id: terminate_invalid_teams
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "failure"
      message: "One or both teams do not belong to the specified league."

  - id: terminate_conflict
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "failure"
      message: "Scheduling conflict detected: a team already has a game on the specified date."
